purpose: First shared-host comparison; not an idle-machine or steady-state claim
host_isolation: shared host, performance governor; no services stopped or cores reserved

scenarios.name: startup
scenarios.claim: Fresh measurement-adapter process; inspect whole-process time

scenarios.name: array-empty
scenarios.claim: Entry, loop check and result serialization floor; do not subtract it

scenarios.name: array-build
scenarios.claim: Append copy and traversal; backing-store allocation differs by runtime

scenarios.name: sort-random
scenarios.claim: Copy, merge sort and full-result serialization

scenarios.name: json-aggregate
scenarios.claim: Parse, validate, group, sort and encode

scenarios.name: allocation-low-retention
scenarios.claim: Natural collection under churn; retain 4 of 128 batches per job

scenarios.name: allocation-high-retention
scenarios.claim: Same churn with 16 times as many retained batches

scenarios.name: async-fanout
scenarios.claim: Concurrent timer waiting and retained payload; no parallel CPU scaling claim

scenarios.name: calls-empty
scenarios.claim: Loop-entry and result-string cost with no leaf calls

scenarios.name: calls
scenarios.claim: Source-level leaf-call loop; optimizer may inline or remove calls

scenarios.name: calls-no-sink
scenarios.claim: Same work with BTEL processing and no recording destination
